interpretation: The center n64 s15 SAT reproduces an existing upper bound. It is calibration in the final plan; no novel frontier bound was obtained. Original trial plan retained below.

trial_plan.goal: Tighten finite base-2 MSD DFAO bounds for the single-seed center column, with matched random and Thue-Morse controls. Prioritize unresolved state boundaries; stop when new proposals are needed.
